problems: The house pictogram's roof boards don't meet at a ridge. From the 25° camera one looks nearly flat and the other steep, and the chimney floats on top, so the house doesn't read as having a pitched roof. Rebuild it with explicit eave and ridge points and turn the whole pictogram to face the camera.
There's no surface under the planks, so the gaps between them show the green backdrop as bright lines, including along the right edge. Add a dark wood floor under the planks.
The coil and the twisting tail are made of too few boxes and show stair-steps, worst at the twist. Use more segments.
The leather renders orange, not leather brown. Darken it.

The strap is built from many short beveled boxes, and each bevel leaves a groove. The coil and the twisting tail look ribbed and segmented, like a chain of blocks, not one smooth leather strap. The restyle would keep those segments. Fix: no bevel on the strap segments, and more, shorter segments so the strap reads as one continuous band.

The roof of the house pictogram is two separate boards with a dark notch between them at the ridge. It reads as two loose sticks, not a pitched roof. Fix: one solid triangular gable over the walls, with the chimney rising from the right slope behind it.
The leather renders light orange-tan. Darken it so it reads as brown leather.
